t: This is Margravine Cemetery, also known as Hammersmith Cemetery, in the London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham. Barons Court is the nearest Underground station. Several people with creative lives are buried here. Charles Keene was an artist and illustrator who worked in black and white. Peggy Webling was a playwright whose 1927 stage version of Frankenstein named the creature after its creator, and it inspired the classic 1931 film. Nora Chesson was a poet and journalist, widely published in the periodicals of her day. The actor Roy Byford and the Royal Ballet dancer Derek Rencher also rest here.
